mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_equipment (project_id, equipment_id, rental_id, added_by, purpose) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{equipmentId}, #{rentalId}, #{addedBy}, #{purpose})
mapper.select: SELECT pe.id, pe.project_id AS projectId, pe.equipment_id AS equipmentId, pe.rental_id AS rentalId, pe.added_by AS addedBy, pe.purpose, pe.added_at AS addedAt, e.name AS equipmentName, u.name AS renterName FROM project_equipment pe LEFT JOIN equipment e ON pe.equipment_id = e.id LEFT JOIN equipment_rentals er ON pe.rental_id = er.id LEFT JOIN users u ON er.user_id = u.id WHERE pe.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY pe.added_at DESC

SELECT er.id AS rentalId, er.equipment_id AS equipmentId, er.user_id AS addedBy, e.name AS equipmentName, u.name AS renterName, er.purpose FROM equipment_rentals er LEFT JOIN equipment e ON er.equipment_id = e.id LEFT JOIN users u ON er.user_id = u.id WHERE er.user_id = #{userId} AND er.return_date IS NULL AND er.is_approved = TRUE AND er.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RENTED') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_equipment pe WHERE pe.project_id = #{projectId} AND pe.rental_id = er.id ) ORDER BY er.rent_date DESC
